p.s: It is debatable whether students concentrate on ther major or learn about a variety of knowledges.
Some people say that students have to concentrate on their majors because it is better easy to find their jobs.
However, I strongly believe that students should have broad knowledge because the knoledge makes students well-rounded persons.
In addition, students meet many different people who help them have more tolerant respectivities.
First of all, taking various classes makes students well-rouded persons.
In order to success, they also need physical health.
Taking physical education help student stay in shape.
For example, my cousin who was suffer from obesity in order to be healthy, he took a dance class.
As result of it, he could lose his weigh through the class.
He could also more concentrated on studying, in the end he could get a sholarship.
I think that if he just had focused on his major, he had not had these positive effects.
In addtion, students can meet new people with different repectivities.
It is very important for them to live the rest of their life.
Also, in fact, the knowledge gives them more opportunities to find job.
For example, I taked a discussion class when I was a freshman in a college.
Then I could learn about other people 's opinions about the same topic.
Eventually, this experience helped me to find jobs.
According an article, many big corporations actually want the people who have various knowledges.
That; s because they think the various abilities help them in many aspects of business field.
In conclusion, as students take various subjects, they can develop their abilities and find their talents.
Without any doubts, you should better experience in various fields.
